semantics: Displayed guide prices remain guide prices, not achieved sale prices.
Auction date is retained from the official Auction House London dated livestream index.
Lot number, address, guide price and marketing property type are crosschecked against the official Auction House London current aggregate.
Tenure remains explicitly not_exposed_in_compact_crosscheck because it was not captured for every selected row.
Publisher descriptions were not converted into legal title, lawful-use, parcel or geometry proof.
Lots 129 and 151 were excluded because the official aggregate marks them Sold Prior.
Lot 177 was excluded because its location is outside England.
Fourteen rows overlapping recent North West, South West or South Yorkshire source groups were excluded before selection.
Lots 107 and 109 were withheld because earlier selected lots used the same addresses and aggregate-only evidence was insufficient to eliminate separate-interest ambiguity.
Nine representative exact-address repository searches returned no prior match for the selected source slice.
Duplicate prevention was bounded to recent waves, regional exclusions, exact-address searches and the current batch; it is not a complete historical title or UPRN scan.
